text: But it's only nature that every moth has turned Better watch out, the train is coming down You thank that your warships fill in all the extra credit I see that you pay Tell them that you can fill the ranks of your troops even from there you can't pay Father, you were a lunar and the brain of the earth remembers me far in too late The sun's too far above the peak of this war
